chaining: each model carries its own quota, so one account holds several separate pools; Free Tokens Only mode stops service at the quota and cannot accrue a charge

free_tier.stated: A one-time free inference quota per model, 500K tokens per model, granted to new users on registration. It is calculated separately for each model and shared under the primary account, offsets pay-as-you-go online inference tokens only, and in Free Tokens Only mode the service is suspended near the quota so no fee accrues. The activity page states the quota does not expire but is subject to change

limits.value: 500K tokens per model, one-time; offsets online pay-as-you-go inference only, not batch inference, plugins, knowledge bases or context-cache storage

Model-list maximums per primary account (theoretical, subject to platform load; all endpoints of a base model share them), for the models the pricing page lists at 500k tokens: Seed 2.0 lite, mini, code-preview and pro 30K RPM and 1500K TPM; DeepSeek V4 pro and flash 260425 versions 15K RPM and 1500K TPM; DeepSeek V4 pro-ga and flash-ga 0.5K RPM and 1000K TPM; Seed 2.1 turbo 0.5K RPM and 1000K TPM (its free-quota row reads 500 tokens); retiring Seed 1.8 30K RPM and 1500K TPM, Seed 1.6 and Seed 1.6 flash 15K RPM and 800K TPM, DeepSeek V3.2 15K RPM and 1500K TPM. Skylark-pro has no row on the model list; which model version carries the quota is not stated

binding_note: the per-model 500K token quota is the only stated cap

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for email, username and password, or Google or GitHub sign-in. The quota page says to register and authenticate as a BytePlus user; the help centre says individual accounts reach a limited subset of products, business accounts need a business license and company details, and a valid credit card may be required to activate pay-as-you-go models; Free Tokens Only mode is open to identity-verified personal accounts and enterprise accounts; the campaign terms require enterprise information submission and judge uniqueness from email verification, ID documents, domain names, mobile numbers, devices and IP addresses. unverified: whether a card, phone number or identity verification is required before the quota is granted, which only an account shows

reliability_note: a separate Data Collaboration Rewards Campaign advertising 5M tokens daily per model behind real-name verification: the campaign page calls it an ongoing benefit while the activity page carries an earlier stated end date; daily resource pack distribution for 18 models, among them Seed 2.0 pro, lite and mini, Seed 1.6, 1.8, DeepSeek V3.2 and V4 pro and flash GA, ended on October 8, 2026
confidence_note: quota size and scope are documented; the identity requirement is unverified beyond the quoted terms
